test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The officials are expected to announce the result.

options.text: The result is expected to be announced by the officials.
The result was announced by the officials.
The result has announced by officials.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The officials are expected to announce the result."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the result" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "are expected to announce" to "is expected to be announced" (present passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the officials."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The result is expected to be announced by the officials."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The result was announced by the officials." – Incorrect tense (past tense).
 
• **Option 3: **"The result has announced by officials." – Incorrect grammar (missing "been" in present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The officials announce the result." – This is active voice, not passive voice.
